findings.evidence: The former render belonged to a superseded dual-objective release and could not certify the corrected reader source.
findings.fix_required: Build, extract, render, inspect and identity-bind the total-return-only release.
findings.resolution: The current 20-page release was built twice, text-extracted and visually inspected. No clipping, overlap, unreadable CJK glyph, table truncation or overfull hbox was observed.
